name: Beach hunting with a Warrior
description: Earn as much XP as possible in ten minutes in Beach Hunting Ground. Hunt naturally respawning Pigs and Ribbon Pigs, navigate shallow changes in the ground, and manage a finite potion supply. An empty moment is not the end of the trial: wait for normal respawns. Basic attacks save MP; Power Strike costs MP. No loot collection or automatic potion use is available.
